summary: Viavi Solutions filed an 8-K reporting an underwritten public offering of 11,111,111 shares of common stock at $45.00 per share, with the underwriters fully exercising a 30-day option for an additional 1,666,666 shares. Net proceeds of approximately $557.2 million will be used to repay a $450 million term loan facility entered into in March 2025, with any excess for working capital or general corporate purposes. The underwriting agreement includes customary representations, warranties, indemnification, and lock-up arrangements for a 60-day period. This is a routine capital markets transaction—a public equity offering with proceeds earmarked for debt repayment—not a special situation event.
